children: that represents the autumn (or fall) months of the year. This map has been remade several times since its addition to the game.

takes place in a forest during the fall season. The grass and leaves of this map were tinted orange to represent the autumn season. There is a river with multiple bridges above it that enemies use as a path, which splits the forest in half. The terrain of the forest is mountainous, with mountains surrounding a large part of the forest. Multiple wooden lanterns can be seen next to the black stone path. A small camp can also be seen on this map, with two green tents and a campfire.

The cobblestone path begins and ends at two caves on the two islands. The path crosses over three wooden bridges when it goes over the river.

took place on two islands in the middle of the ocean during the fall season. The grass and leaves of this map were tinted orange to represent the autumn season. These islands were separated by a river connected to the same ocean. In the river, there were lily pads and a small grass mound. The terrain was mountainous, with mountains surrounding most of the islands. There were wooden viewing platforms and lanterns. A country farm house could be seen on this map. A pumpkin, hay bales and a wheatfield could be seen outside the house. A large tree canopy dominated most of the map.

The cobblestone path began and ended at two caves on the two islands. The path crossed over three wooden bridges when it went over the river.
was exactly like the fourth version, except the bridges were humped as opposed to flat. The sides of the bridge were also open.
was exactly like the first version, except that the baseplate water was replaced by terrain water. This version only appeared in Hardcore Testing.

took place on a large island, though the island itself is surrounded by mountains. Around the map, there was a mix between slender trees and large tree canopies. Both types of trees had orange leaves. Several wooden cabins could be seen around the map, as well as campfires, pumpkins and hay bales. Lanterns also lined the path. A small pond could be found near the middle of the map, with lily pads appearing in the pond.

The black path began and ended at two caves. The path crossed over the pond on a wooden bridge.

Most of your towers should be placed around the trees, specifically the area next to the river, as these areas allow your towers to cover most of the path.
This area also has a decent amount of cliffs.
